meta.parties: In Re Part Cargo Ex M v. 'Maro Y'

rules.statement: The Marshal's clause absolved the purchaser of any right to remission of price, and this was a binding agreement that could not be challenged by the petitioners.
rules.supporting_quote: "To my mind, it is a conclusive defence to the petitioners' claim that they agreed to the stipulation made by the Marshal that 'the purchaser shall not be entitled to any remission of the purchase price on any ground whatsoever'."
